is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles arabiensis and Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 4).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotypes for Vgsc L995F (page 8), Ace-1 (page 8), and various CNVs including Cyp6aa/Cyp6p and Coeae clusters (page 5-6).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 provides sample sizes for resistant/susceptible groups. Page 8 provides specific counts for Vgsc-995F haplotypes (2 out of 564 in Moshi, 0 out of 324 in Muleba).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field sites in Moshi and Muleba, Tanzania (page 4, 13).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study conducting GWAS and bioassays on field-collected samples.

sub_country_location.evidence: Samples were collected from Moshi and Muleba, Tanzania, with specific coordinates provided (page 13).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Samples were collected from June to August 2018 (page 13).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper states samples were sequenced as part of the MalariaGEN Vector Observatory release Ag3.7, but this is a primary analysis of these specific samples for resistance phenotypes.

supplement.evidence: The provided PDF contains the necessary information, and supplementary data is referenced as being available.

assessment.summary: This study performs a genome-wide association study (GWAS) on Anopheles arabiensis from two regions in Tanzania (Moshi and Muleba) to investigate the molecular mechanisms of resistance to deltamethrin and pirimiphos-methyl. The study identifies new copy number variants (CNVs) in carboxylesterase gene clusters (Coeae2g-Coeae6g) associated with resistance, while finding that target-site resistance mutations (Vgsc) are rare.
